# 086 — Independent SOURCE review

RU candidate 53f975caac49384a00757f9d0774c875e8c0d768; branch full-ru-086-giving-preparation-and-interaction-kanji. Accepted RU baseline b862bc1feaff0b79441de2ce8610af392393db26; frozen EN 6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f; premutation c6aedb4f5c508b82babb1c104287f63ceaeb0c62; candidate version 7a11fb6dc2ec2efd.
A artifact RAW SHA256 identities:
- scope: ccf1f686b1da3e237ac0a77ace7042e829d5df2212a91dd9973ebbc1d7ab447a
- current typed pool: 34cf768fbc15dfa2ddb62acc2b2a3213dbb8ccd78a7180de81c8a6207e030c81
- candidate evidence binding: 0a0100c71d2254db4feef2541720a54d92ac6d9f6881ce3b0781926d236e6a9b
RAW, GitRAW, LF-manifest, archive and report domains are distinct. Correct RU-root rubric identities were checked, not compared to EN namesakes.

Actual full reading: 65 teaching bodies, 35 EN/30 current RU (six primary pairs, 24 context pairs, five EN-only comparisons including all 201 kaeru-article lines); 181 official TEXT units (19 KANJIDIC records, four Unicode keyrows, 152 ordered-field JMdict objects, six KanjiPedia entries), plus one whole KANJIDIC header; 267 current typed metadata units, NOT whole lessons. Also all 18 historical directions/17 active, one M001, six L rulings, six separate A clarifications, six outside observations, 11 NAV-only diffs/11 wrappers, four whole current RU guidance files and three whole RU rubrics. All requested payload windows succeeded. Initial and final read-only gates passed.

## C1 — Correctness

Verdict: CLEAN within assigned SOURCE authoring; no remaining significant factual defect established. These dispositions are independent, not adopted author conclusions.

- L001 supported: 与's giving/providing core is nonexclusive and not universally higher-to-lower. A001 supported: 与る（あずかる）means participation/receiving, usually kana (JMdict1544760), distinct from custody 預かる (1544970). 与する（くみする）supports participation/siding with (1544750); KanjiPedia与④ supports ともに, not a reading of 与える.
- L002 supported, including M001 below: 予 preserves ヨ/シャ/あらかじ.め; 予定/予想 are not declared universally exclusive. A002 supported: 予め is usually kana (1542860); シャ is preserved without invented illustration. Literary self-reference, giving and other KanjiPedia senses remain distinct from selected «заранее».
- L003 supported: 争 preserves its broad contest/dispute core, not only armed conflict. A003 supported: KanjiPedia0004201300③ explicitly attests rhetorical いかでか; an exact JMdict miss cannot refute it. 争う is godan: 争います/争わない/争って. The contested goal in 優勝を争う is compatible with its intransitive dictionary label; that label does not prohibit every を construction. 戦争 also has figurative competition senses.
- L004 supported: 両's pair focus coexists with currency/vehicle-counter extensions. A004 supported: source てる/ふたつ are preserved; KanjiPedia0007152100 actually lists 両つ（ふたつ）. Separate JMdict テール/りゃん/リャン records do not explain てる or establish frequency. No unattested gloss or substitution into 両方/両手 is invented.
- L005 supported: 互 does not imply friendship/agreement. A005 supported: 1268810 gives 互に（かたみに）, NOT 互みに. 互い is noun/no-noun (1268770), not an い-adjective; 互いに and 互いの名前 preserve distinct constructions.
- L006 supported: 交 retains all ten kun entries: まじ.わる/まじ.える/ま.じる/まじ.る/ま.ざる/ま.ぜる/-か.う/か.わす/かわ.す/こもごも. A006 supported: duplicate dot placements are not different pronunciations. 交える is まじえる, not かえる (1271660); 交わす is かわす (1590750). 行き交う has いきかう/ゆきかう (1281700). Standalone 交（こもごも）is attested, usually kana (1593420). 混/交 preferences are not absolute spelling bans. The whole kaeru article supports the distinctions; Russian explanation replaces its unavailable RU link.

M001: independently SUPPORT withdrawing historical N006 ONLY. KanjiPedia予0006906300(B)② says「あたえる。あずかる」「類 与」; 与0006904500① says「あたえる」. Actual offered 与 answer «давать; предоставлять» therefore cannot be wrong across all attested 予 senses. Current RU予 front matter, line11, already has [子, 手], versus EN [子, 手, 与]. This resolves that explicit source-array defect, NOT fallback selection. Two distinct distractors meet the stated existing minimum. No schema change, replacement, reciprocal/transitive deletion or scope shrink follows. Independent support is not acceptance into main.

All six roots retain frozen community N3 classification; old KANJIDIC JLPT2 tags are not that classification. Japanese IDs/readings/levels/strokes/radicals/tags/fragments/examples remain source-bound apart from localized titles and named M001. 六 classical 八/12 versus frozen EN 亠/8, and 子's distractor correction, are inherited—not new086 fixes. Modern-shape mnemonics claim no historical image evidence.

## C2 — Dependencies and qualified quiz scope

Verdict: assigned SOURCE dependency/NAV coverage CLEAN; quiz conclusions QUALIFIED. The 11 diffs only link existing explanatory glyphs to new lessons; no existing word semantic amendments. Assigned counterparts are present and read. EN-only 与える/予想/争う/互い and the article are comparisons, not RU runtime providers; 争う is frozen N2, 予想 has no jlpt field. Six identical source strokes and source/license bindings were gate-checked, not pixel-viewed or build-tested.

Individual directions: Q supports ONLY the forward introductory core-meaning contrast after considering assigned whole lessons and dictionary senses/readings. It is NOT every-sense, reading-mode, reverse, fallback or future-pool clearance.

- N001 与→写: Q. «копировать; фотографировать» is not granting/participating; copying something given is only a shared situation.
- N002 与→五: Q. «пять» is numerical, not giving/participation; contour resemblance supplies no number meaning.
- N003 与→予: Q. Actual offered «заранее» is not established for 与. 予's giving sense does not reverse this question. Shared ヨ/shared giving senses forbid blanket separation; N006 implies no reciprocal deletion.
- N004 予→子: Q. «ребёнок» is not preparation/self-reference/giving/permission; planning for a child is only a situation.
- N005 予→手: Q. «рука» is not selected or extended 予 meanings; preparing by hand is not lexical identity.
- N006 予→与: WITHDRAWAL SUPPORTED through M001: offered giving matches an attested 予 sense.
- N007 争→急: Q. «срочность; внезапность» is not contention/rhetorical questioning; time pressure is insufficient.
- N008 争→書: Q. «писать» is not disputing/rhetorical use; a written dispute does not make 争 mean writing.
- N009 争→予: Q. «заранее» is not contention; forecasting a contest differs from contesting it.
- N010 両→雨: Q. «дождь» does not express pair/currency/counter uses; similar interiors do not establish meaning.
- N011 両→内: Q. «внутри; внутренний» is not pairing/monetary/counting uses; enclosure of two things is insufficient.
- N012 両→西: Q. «запад» is not pairing/currency/counting; additional readings do not establish this directional answer.
- N013 互→五: Q. «пять» is not reciprocity/alternation. Shared ゴ explicitly prevents reading-mode clearance.
- N014 互→工: Q. «ремесло; строительство» is not mutuality; cooperative work is only a shared situation.
- N015 互→西: Q. «запад» is not reciprocity/alternation; western participants do not supply directional meaning.
- N016 交→父: Q. «отец» is not crossing/mixing/exchange/association; interaction with a father is insufficient.
- N017 交→文: Q. «предложение; письменный текст» is not the interaction relation; exchanging words does not mean the text itself.
- N018 交→六: Q. «шесть» is not crossing/mixing/interaction; similar upper contours confer no numerical meaning.

Six outside observations support limited warnings: 与 giving/offering/lending; 予 prior/planning plus self-reference/giving; 争 urgency/strength/effort contexts; 両 two/currency/vehicles; 互 reciprocal/group/interaction; 交 mixing/exchange/communication. These are not new guards or fresh whole-body adjudications of outside providers. No exhaustive global matrix or reciprocal/transitive guards are approved.

## C3 — Natural Russian

Verdict: CLEAN within the 30 complete current RU bodies; no substantive natural-Russian/comprehension defect established. Core titles and prose preserve participation, mixing, nonexclusive pair/forecast senses and social/construction qualifications without requiring English or creating false Russian equivalents. This is editorial judgment, not native-speaker certification or measured learning effectiveness.

Limits: ordinary quiz/fallback safety, unrestricted all-sense separation, modern necessity/frequency and global/future uniqueness remain UNVERIFIED. Removing explicit N006 is not a fallback exclusion. Protected033 WORD 空 remains excluded/C2 UNVERIFIED, not media; accepted KANJI 空 does not resolve it. Prior082-N007 姉→妹 remains U, not upgraded. No fresh1478-word guard review, 267-whole-lesson review, image pixels, media/device access, network verification, builds/tests, writes, delegation, Git/auth mutation or default/release activation occurred. Candidate2042 is not accepted main: main remains2030. C6/C7 do not block independently reviewed source authoring. Full8278-object objective remains unfinished.
